title: Opening Lines
story: The ledger service failed during startup. Before chasing its final complaint, the team wants the first three lines that describe how the launch began.
objective: Print exactly the first three lines of /var/log/ledger/startup.log.
hints: head reads from the beginning of a file.
The -n option controls how many lines are printed.
explanation: head keeps an initial log inspection focused. It is useful for finding startup context without printing an entire large file.

files.content:
08:00 INFO ledger starting
08:00 INFO loading configuration
08:01 INFO connecting to database
08:01 WARN retrying connection
08:02 ERROR startup timed out
